section.title: Introduction
section.content: This manual provides detailed information on the inseration of SIM card to mobile phone and make a call .

section.title: Procedure
section.content: To insert the SIM card, open the slot at the right side of the mobile with the help of pin. Open the slot, place the SIM card in the slot 1. Close the slot,wait till screen shows the nertwork signal.

section.title: Safety
section.content: Do not place in moisture place.

section.title: Operation
section.content: After the Network display, open contact and call to required number.

section.title: Troubleshooting
section.content: If Network signal is not showned in the mobile scereen, reinsert the SIM card.

section.title: Maintenance
section.content: wash the mobile phone with dry cloth.
